description: List every layer in the FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer MapServer with its id, name and geometry type, plus a plain-English guide to the layers that matter (flood hazard zones, base flood elevations, LOMRs, LOMAs, FIRM panels, levees, NFHL availability). Call this before nfhl_query.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring to filter layer names, e.g. "flood", "levee"

name: nfhl_layers
title: Nfhl Layers
